verdicts.reason: A keeps the purple headline as the clear focal point, but the small 'EVENT MANAGMENT' kicker is stranded in the top-left, away from the headline it introduces. Confetti also sits among the headline letters, and the blue owl is cropped and squeezed into the bottom. B blows the red kicker up to near-headline size and wraps it onto two lines, so it competes with the shrunken headline. That breaks the hierarchy, and B has the same confetti clutter and owl crowding as A.
